entries.21854fae578ea1c4: An electronics trading company that purchases semiconductors, electronic components, and electronic application equipment such as aerospace equipment and medical equipment from manufacturers in Japan and abroad and sells them.
entries.6e7868236b34a97d: This business sells ICT solutions, AI robots, module products, software and technology licenses. The company sells these products, and FORESIGHT TECHNO CO., LTD. provides maintenance and technical services for ICT solutions. Previously named the "Solution Business," the business was renamed in the fiscal year ended March 2026, when it transferred some businesses that had been included in the former Device Business and changed its name. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 2,556 million yen.
entries.ea4de071861c7fc6: This business sells electronic application equipment, including aerospace equipment, manufacturing and inspection equipment, laser equipment and medical equipment. Besides the company, consolidated subsidiaries Marubun Tsusho Co., Ltd. (mainly in the Hokuriku region) and Marubun West Co., Ltd. (Kinki, Chugoku and Shikoku regions) sell, and FORESIGHT TECHNO CO., LTD. provides maintenance and technical services for electronic application equipment. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, demand related to artificial satellites grew significantly, and revenue from external customers was 58,623 million yen.
